effects.text: The directory shows Wanderlust Getaways and Paper Haven to the south. Brewed Awakening and Gourmet Glutton face them across the concourse.
Sunlit beaches stare out from faded posters. Behind the travel desks, two doors lead to the employee office and supply closet.
Notebooks and pens cover the display. Narrow aisles wind between the shelves, with a stockroom at the back.
The espresso machine is silent. Tables crowd the floor, and a stockroom door sits behind the counter.
A sour smell rises from the gourmet shelves. The refrigerated pantry is dark. Something scrapes against a shelf.
A cot and a supply box fit behind the office door. With one way in, this room could shelter the group between supply runs.
A jammed fire shutter seals the east wing. Another route will be needed.
Casey: I can help. Let us get everyone out of here together.
Robin: You are alive. Good. I know where they kept the spare supplies.
Carry newly found supplies to the shelter stockpile. Starting gear and supplies already here do not earn experience. Use Store Finds or deposit individual stacks.

expedition.title: A Place to Hold
expedition.briefing: The west entrance offers a foothold. Read the directory, find an office refuge and help the survivors hiding nearby. Check all four shops, clear the threats, then return with at least 10 SV of scavenged supplies. Gather everyone in the back office and use the expedition report board to finish.
expedition.successText: The southwest shops are quiet, four survivors have a place to gather, and the office stockpile can support the next supply run. This is a foothold in the mall. Keep the supplies safe and plan the next expedition.
